headline: UPDATE to totw-20261025-1300-03 (Taiwan Restoration Day) -- Song Tao pledges backing for pro-unification "patriots"

sources: Song Tao, head of Beijing's Taiwan Affairs Office (Fuzhou event, via Xinhua); CCTV satellite video; CGTN anniversary coverage
fault_line: One Chinese nation / inevitable reunion vs a separate Taiwanese identity that does not mark this date.

sections.what_happened: Beijing marked the 81st anniversary of the end of Japanese rule in Taiwan ("Taiwan Restoration Day", established as an official memorial date last year). At a Fuzhou event, Taiwan Affairs Office head Song Tao said Beijing "firmly supports patriotic pro-unification forces on the island", cited 10 policy measures rolled out this year to foster cross-strait exchanges and integration, and said compatriots must "resolutely oppose Taiwan independence separatism and external interference". CCTV released a 42-second Jilin-1 satellite video over Taiwan captioned "This is the Taiwan province of China", zooming on Taipei landmarks, closing "reunion will come in time". A Fuzhou symposium also ran with participants from both sides of the Strait. No military exercise, incursion or mobilisation was reported in the coverage found.
sections.what_verified: Declared-tier count: 1 family only — Xinhua (T3, STATE CN) for Song Tao's speech; SCMP and CGTN carry the campaign but hold NO declared tier in the registry and are reported with attribution only, never counted. Record states primary_source_single_family explicitly per the pass gate.
sections.what_disputed: Taiwan's ruling DPP traditionally pays less attention to this date; the opposition KMT/blue camp marks it — the anniversary is contested domestically in Taiwan, not a shared commemoration. No independent evidence of a policy change beyond messaging was found in this scan.
sections.why_matters: Beijing turned an 81-year-old date into a satellite flyover and a promise to Taiwan's "patriots" — messaging, not mobilisation, so far.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to totw-20261025-1300-03 (Taiwan Restoration Day) -- Song Tao pledges backing for pro-unification "patriots"; CCTV satellite video of Taiwan; 10 cross-strait policy measures cited

totw_analysis: Our read: Beijing turned an 81-year-old date into a satellite flyover and a promise to Taiwan's "patriots" — messaging, not mobilisation, so far. The fault line our audience is arguing over: One Chinese nation / inevitable reunion vs a separate Taiwanese identity that does not mark this date.
